items.reason: “王吩咐人捉拿谁？”直接询问捉拿的对象；“捉住他！”中的“他”指向神人，选项中只有 A 标识这一人物。
问句清楚，只有一个作答对象。米迦对母亲说“我听见你咒诅它”，直接支持 C。
“之后他们决定怎么做”承接一个清楚的说话事件，没有多层转述。“我们往叙利亚营去”及随后的生死条件支持 C。
The question directly asks what covered the road. Verse 15 explicitly identifies “clothing and equipment.”
“want the Levite to ask God” requires two-layer request tracking: the Danites’ request to the Levite and his intended inquiry to God. The target is supported, but this wording needs simplification.
“被那附着邪灵的人制服以后，谁……”先呈现省略受事者的被动时间结构，再延后询问该人物；其中还嵌入“附着邪灵的”修饰语。目标有据，但应避免这种延迟识别。
“带他回来的先知宣告”中的“他”没有在问句中明确指称；后面的“他列祖”又需要重新追踪所属人物。目标有据，但人物指称应更明确。

The expected answer distinguishes “a graven image” and “a molten idol,” but the supplied speech lists only “an ephod, some household gods and an image overlaid with silver.” The four-object target is unsupported.
The question clearly asks for the reason behind Micah’s belief. His statement supplies it explicitly: “since this Levite has become my priest.”

“Shechem’s leaders” are not identified as the victims of the fire. The passage describes citizens killed in several attacks and people burned inside the temple stronghold, so the stated victim group does not uniquely support the expected answer.
